research_attempts.research_notes: Exact-name, spelling-variant, employer, obituary, newspaper and archival searches produced no defensible identity bridge. Exact-name OSS, employer, occupation, obituary, institutional, newspaper, official-domain, CIA Reading Room-equivalent and Library of Congress searches were checked as applicable. The index page, Army bulk file, technical documentation and occupation-code pages were inspected directly. No search-result snippet was used as sole final evidence, no access control was bypassed, and no authenticated NARA Catalog API call was made.
research_attempts.next_action: Review the indexed Box 788 personnel file for corroborating identifiers, the immediate pre-OSS affiliation and the last civilian employer before wartime service.
